response.sql: WITH state_accounts AS (SELECT COALESCE(c.state_county_province, 'No State') AS state, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN Accounts a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY COALESCE(c.state_county_province, 'No State')), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(account_count) AS total FROM state_accounts), state_shares AS (SELECT sa.state, sa.account_count, sa.account_count * 100.0 / tc.total AS share FROM state_accounts sa CROSS JOIN total_count tc), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM state_shares), above_avg AS (SELECT ss.account_count, ss.share, asg.avg_share FROM state_shares ss CROSS JOIN avg_share asg WHERE ss.share > asg.avg_share) SELECT SUM(account_count) AS combined_account_base, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS above_average_amount FROM above_avg
